offering digital solutions and automation through custom application development and integration services. We have a track record of twenty￾six years in designing, implementing and operating digital platforms for Government entities and Enterprises in India and select overseas markets. 
Our activities are organised across three verticals: (i) healthcare, (ii) electronic governance, and (iii) telecommunications and broadband.
In addition to the above-mentioned verticals, we are also strengthening our capabilities in artificial intelligence through the development and 
deployment of AI-enabled solutions in order to strengthen our service offerings.

IT services include software development, system integration, infrastructure management, and consulting, while BPM (also known as BPO)
